const ITERATIONS = 500; // phải trùng với C#
const codeEn = document.currentScript.dataset.code;
alert("haha: " + codeEn);
var keyEn = '<@@session_string:' + codeEn + '@@>';

// Uint8Array -> CryptoJS WordArray
function toWordArray(u8) {
  const words = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i++) {
    words[i >>> 2] |= u8[i] << (24 - (i % 4) * 8);
  }
  return CryptoJS.lib.WordArray.create(words, u8.length);
}

function decryptBox(base64Data) {
  const raw = Uint8Array.from(atob(base64Data), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
  if (raw.length < 16 + 16 + 16 + 32) throw new Error("Dữ liệu không hợp lệ");

  const salt   = raw.slice(0, 16);
  const iv     = raw.slice(16, 32);
  const cipher = raw.slice(32, raw.length - 32);
  const mac    = raw.slice(raw.length - 32);
  const body   = raw.slice(0, raw.length - 32);

  // Sinh 64 byte (16 word) giống C#
  const derived = CryptoJS.PBKDF2(keyEn, toWordArray(salt), {
    keySize: 16,
    iterations: ITERATIONS,
    hasher: CryptoJS.algo.SHA256
  });
  const aesKey = CryptoJS.lib.WordArray.create(derived.words.slice(0, 8), 32);
  const macKey = CryptoJS.lib.WordArray.create(derived.words.slice(8, 16), 32);

  // Kiểm tra HMAC trước: sai key hoặc dữ liệu bị sửa sẽ dừng ở đây
  const expectedMac = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(toWordArray(body), macKey).toString();
  const actualMac = toWordArray(mac).toString();
  if (expectedMac !== actualMac) {
    throw new Error("Error code!");
  }

  const decrypted = CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(
    { ciphertext: toWordArray(cipher) },
    aesKey,
    { iv: toWordArray(iv), mode: CryptoJS.mode.CBC, padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7 }
  );
  return decrypted.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8);
}
